html: The Seikarte are the only intelligent lifeforms native to the planet Seika. At time of First Contact in 2071, the most advanced societies on the planet were organized into soilworks building heading communities, with a limited form of agriculture used to cultivate fodder for livestock and a type of highly fibrous or "wood" grass-like reed used in both construction and fabric. The Seikarte are one of the first Sophonts to be popularly labeled a "Wood Age" civilization, a term used to describe the bulk of post-paleolithic societies observed by humanity.
title: Seikarte
